fieldValues.title: The central group undertakes all undelegated work
fieldValues.decision_question: Who does work that no working group has been given?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner on 2026-10-11, while unblocking general-lane work that no working group could claim (clerk#46, clerk#47); awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: The central group undertakes any work that does not fall within the delegated authority of a working group.
fieldValues.rationale: Work outside every charter still needs an owner; otherwise it cannot be claimed and stalls.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When undelegated work in one area grows steady enough to meet the threshold for chartering a working group.
